module_summary: AXI4 N-by-M crossbar wrapper that splits traffic into an independent write crossbar (AW/W/B) and read crossbar (AR/R), each with address decode and round-robin arbitration.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Per-slave-port write address valid into the write crossbar.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address decoded to select destination master port.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data from upstream masters routed through write crossbar.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid returned to upstream masters.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Per-slave-port read address valid into the read crossbar.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address decoded to select destination master port.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to upstream masters.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Arbitrated write address valid toward downstream slaves.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Write address forwarded to selected downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Write data muxed toward downstream slaves.

anchors.name: m_axi_awid
anchors.why: Extended write ID carrying source port bits for B routing.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Arbitrated read address valid toward downstream slaves.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Read address forwarded to selected downstream slave.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from downstream slaves, routed back by ID.

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid from downstream slaves.

groups.name: Write crossbar
groups.description: axi_crossbar_wr: decodes AW, arbitrates per master port, routes W and B.

groups.name: Read crossbar
groups.description: axi_crossbar_rd: decodes AR, arbitrates per master port, routes R back.
